name: Princess Corruption!
source: Kokoro discovered a strange magic lamp. Curiously, she touched it, only to be sucked into it. When she emerged from the lamp, she had already become a loyal servant of the Corrupt. What fate awaits her two friends, Pecorine and Karyl?
translation: 心发现了一盏奇怪的神灯。奇怪的是，她伸手一触，却被吸了进去。当她从灯中出现时，她已经成为了腐败者的忠实仆人。她的两个朋友Pecorine和Karyl将会面临怎样的命运？
